decision: Measure and validate per-worker probe start/completion envelopes and optional latency budgets.
winner: Local observed start+completion timing around each existing ResourceProbe call.

reviews.correctness: Completion-only evidence cannot prove the whole measurement occurred during the active workload. Start+completion binds the full probe envelope.
reviews.robustness: Fail closed when completion leaves the workload, timing evidence is inconsistent, or a configured probe-latency budget is exceeded.
reviews.latency_resources: No additional qrexec calls, VMs, daemons, or storage. Timing uses the existing local clock around existing probes.
reviews.regression: Calibration/evidence-only change; MissionQueue, coordinator, and worker mutation semantics are untouched.

rejected: Completion offset only: permits long probes whose start is not evidenced.
Remote timestamp service: stronger clock attribution but adds qrexec/service/key lifecycle complexity before real Qubes calibration.
Extra ping probes: increases qrexec traffic and perturbs the measurement being calibrated.
qa: Happy path records sampleStartedOffsetMs, sampleOffsetMs, and probeLatencyMs per worker.
A worker completing outside the workload fails closed.
A probe exceeding maxProbeLatencyMs fails even when completion remains inside the workload.
lesson: Resource evidence must describe the full measurement envelope, not only its completion timestamp.
